Internal helper: can a variable carry a numeric, count or Likert registration?

Source: R/registry-internals.R
dot-jst_takes_numeric_registration.Rd

TRUE for a numeric variable and for a haven-labelled variable whose stored values are numbers – the two storage kinds jnumeric(), jcount() and jlikert() document. Read from .jst_var_kind(), so a factor, a text variable (plain or value-labelled), a logical, a date or time and the unsupported types are all FALSE. One test for the three places that need it: the registration refusal (.jst_check_registration_type()) and the two readers of a stored registration (.jst_jstats_class(), .jst_is_count()), which pass over one that is stored on any other kind of variable.

Usage

.jst_takes_numeric_registration(x)

Arguments

x

A variable.

Value

TRUE or FALSE.
